name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Senior Implementation Manager | CRM Implementation, Data Mapping & Integrations, Change Management, Team Mentoring
summary: Implementation leader with 5+ years building and implementing CRM systems and years of SaaS onboarding, from kickoff through launch and handoff. Configures CRMs (GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce), maps fields, runs and validates data imports (including a 1,400+ contact CRM cleanup), and builds workflow automation and integrations. Led onboarding teams of up to 30 at Wix while managing about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak at 110% of implementation targets, and coached new specialists through every rollout. Guides multiple stakeholders through change, from day-to-day users to the C-suite.

experience.title: CRM Implementation & Integrations (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Lead end-to-end CRM implementations for each client: discovery, project plan, configuration, field mapping and lifecycle stages, data migration, workflow automation, testing, training, and launch.
Run data feeds and imports into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel and validate every record after load.
Built 20+ automated workflows and connected client systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON in Zapier, Make, and n8n.
Coach client teams through the change to a new system, documenting configurations and decisions in Notion and HubSpot so the setup outlasts the launch.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts (~3 at $20K+/month in ad spend each), coordinating internal teams and presenting status and results to client leadership.

experience.title: Partner Onboarding & Enablement (Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding)
bullets: Onboarded 15-20 reseller partner organizations, each with its own end customers, retaining all but one (~94%) through tracking adoption and stepping in early on risk.
Built automated training sequences, guided complex technical setup, and liaised between partners and Product and Engineering on issues and feedback.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built processes in HubSpot, Monday.com, and ClickUp that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed about 25 concurrent onboardings at peak while launching 25+ clients a month at 110% of implementation targets.
Led onboarding teams of up to 30, mentoring specialists through weekly training, 1:1 coaching, and workshops for each new initiative, and helped hire and ramp new team members.
Drove process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, and defined the Salesforce fields used across the team.

experience.title: Implementation Scoping & Solution Consulting (Account Executive)
bullets: Scoped CRM/PSA implementations for professional-services firms and built the sequenced implementation plans the delivery team executed, ranking which systems to change and in what order.
Ran workshops for client teams on how each part of the platform fit their workflow, guided API integrations, and advised C-suite executives on adoption.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
